name: SPAR
description: Spar is the most popular card game in Ghana. It is a trick-taking game without trumps in which the object is to win the last trick. Played by 2 to 4 players (up to 7 possible) with 35 cards from a standard pack. Similar games are played in Benin as Jeu de Carte and in Togo as Sipa. Often played for money or for enjoyment.

content.text: Spar is the most popular card game in Ghana. It is a trick-taking game without trumps in which the object is to win the last trick. Played by 2 to 4 players (up to 7 possible) with 35 cards from a standard pack. Similar games are played in Benin as Jeu de Carte and in Togo as Sipa. Often played for money or for enjoyment.
Likely introduced by European sailors playing Whist or similar games, adapted locally.
35 cards: 6 through Ace in each suit; Ace of Spades normally not used.
35 cards: 6 through Ace in each suit; Ace of Spades normally not used.

First dealer chosen at random; thereafter the winner of each hand deals the next. Five cards to each player: a batch of three to each (starting with player to dealer's left if clockwise), then a batch of two each, ending with the dealer.

items.text: Seven cards: Some deal seven cards each; then max 5 players and the seventh (last) trick is scored.
Include Ace of Spades: Some players include the Ace of Spades so the pack has 36 cards.
Under ten rule: A player dealt no card higher than 9 may trade in all five cards for a new hand before play.
